descriptions.d24l_mode_icon_802c663c: When the button is ready (+36), picks the keyboard mode icon name from +80 (FE.K.Abc, ABC, abc, 123, Abcf for 4 and 5, Tick for 6; empty otherwise leaves it out), detaches and releases the previous icon at +56, loads the new one with type base+32 through a handle built from the name, stores it retained, scales it to half of the button size (+72,+76) and attaches it to the panel +28.
